notes: GovPool.sol:1-40 upgradeable DAO pool behind SphereX beacon proxy; logic split across GovPool* libraries via delegatecall-linked library calls; BlockGuard flash-loan guards on deposit/delegate.
GovPool.sol onlyBABTHolder gate: bypassed only if onlyBABTHolders=false, caller holds BABT, or caller is a registered GovPool; enforced on all user entry points incl. unlock().
GovUserKeeper.sol: custody for deposited tokens/NFTs; onlyOwner (GovPool); lock counting for NFTs (_nftLockedNums) and maxTokensLocked for tokens; WETH unwrap via NetworkProperties.
TokenSaleProposal: ERC1155 whitelist passes; buy pulls payment direct to GovPool/treasury with commission; claim/vesting pay from escrowed sale tokens; recover returns unsold to Gov.
DistributionProposal: execute() pulls reward from GovPool pro-rata to FOR raw votes; claim() pays voters on winning side.
StakingProposal: soft staking (no token movement); shares gate withdrawals via GovUserKeeper._canMove; AbstractValueDistributor cumulative-sum rewards.
GovValidators: snapshot ERC20 voting (non-transferable); internal proposals execute changeBalances/changeSettings/monthlyWithdraw via self-call.
ERC721Power: decaying raw power with collateral floor; totalRawPower accounting fixed for unminted-token recalc (Ambisafe-2 5.4).
ERC721Multiplier: lock flag blocks transfers; unlock() calls back into GovPool.unlock() (BABT-gated) and requires zero active proposals.
DexeERC721Multiplier: UUPS; 10% slashing per unlock capped at 100%; getCurrentMultiplier divides by slashed multiplier.
PoolFactory: CREATE2 beacon proxies per pool type; salt=keccak(tx.origin, poolName); registers ONLY the pool proxy as GOV_POOL; transfers helper ownerships to pool proxy.
PriceFeed/UniswapPathFinder: no on-chain consumer in this codebase (only registry getter); quoting only. LogExpMath: no consumer (dead code).
SphereX ProtectedBeaconProxy/TransparentProxy and OZ/solarity deps are imported contracts (out of scope per program rules).
